# Scene grid (`scene-grid`)

Large tiles that set a scene, with the active scene marked and a brief applied state.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createSceneGrid` (types in `dist/web/home/rooms/sceneGrid.d.ts`): `.mh-scene-grid`: a list of large `button.mh-scene-grid__tile`s (`__icon`, `__label`, `__description`, `__tag`). The scene in effect has `aria-current="true"` and `.is-active`; after a press the tile shows `.is-applied` with a check for `appliedFor` ms and a polite announcement. Sizes `--compact | --large`.

```ts
export function createSceneGrid(options: SceneGridOptions): SceneGridHandle;

export interface SceneGridOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the grid (default "Scenes"). */
  label?: string;
  scenes: readonly Scene[];
  /** The scene in effect now, marked with `aria-current`. */
  active?: string | null;
  /** Larger tiles in fewer columns (wall screens); default `regular`. */
  size?: 'compact' | 'regular' | 'large';
  labels?: Partial<SceneGridLabels>;
  /** How long the applied state shows, in ms. */
  appliedFor?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** A tile was pressed. */
  onActivate?: (id: string) => void;
}

export interface SceneGridHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  update(changes: Partial<SceneGridOptions>): void;
  /** Stops the applied timer. */
  destroy(): void;
}

/** Every visible or spoken word, for translation. */
export interface SceneGridLabels {
  /** Shown on the active tile. */
  active: string;
  /** Shown briefly after a tile is pressed. */
  applied: string;
  /** Announced after a tile is pressed: "Evening set". */
  announce(scene: string): string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { mdiCoffeeOutline, mdiMovieOpenOutline, mdiWeatherNight, mdiWeatherSunset } from '@mdi/js';
import { createSceneGrid, type Scene } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const scenes: Scene[] = [
  { id: 'morning', label: 'Morning', icon: mdiCoffeeOutline, description: 'Bright, cool white' },
  { id: 'evening', label: 'Evening', icon: mdiWeatherSunset, description: 'Dim, warm' },
  { id: 'film', label: 'Film night', icon: mdiMovieOpenOutline, description: 'Lamps low, blinds down' },
  { id: 'night', label: 'Goodnight', icon: mdiWeatherNight, description: 'Everything off' },
];

const grid = createSceneGrid({
  label: 'Scenes',
  scenes,
  active: 'evening',
  onActivate: (id) => grid.update({ active: id }),
});

document.body.append(grid.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { mdiCoffeeOutline, mdiMovieOpenOutline, mdiWeatherNight, mdiWeatherSunset } from '@mdi/js';
import { SceneGrid } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { Scene } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const scenes: Scene[] = [
  { id: 'morning', label: 'Morning', icon: mdiCoffeeOutline, description: 'Bright, cool white' },
  { id: 'evening', label: 'Evening', icon: mdiWeatherSunset, description: 'Dim, warm' },
  { id: 'film', label: 'Film night', icon: mdiMovieOpenOutline, description: 'Lamps low, blinds down' },
  { id: 'night', label: 'Goodnight', icon: mdiWeatherNight, description: 'Everything off' },
];

export function SceneGridExample() {
  const [active, setActive] = useState('evening');
  return <SceneGrid label="Scenes" scenes={scenes} active={active} onActivate={setActive} />;
}
```
